author: KEXP
description: NYC-based duo Widowspeak bloom under rays of indie rock and dream pop on their latest release Roses. With life size flowers spread across the Live Room, the band deliver a delicate performance of "If You Change" and more.
title: Widowspeak performs "If You Change" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG presents Widowspeak performing live in the KEXP studio. Recorded July 31, 2026.

Songs:
The Hook 00:40
No Driver 05:07
Roses 08:50
If You Change 11:52

Molly Hamilton - Vocals, Guitar
Robert Earl Thomas - Lead Guitar
Melanie Drew Chambers - Background Vocals, Keyboard
Willy Muse - Bass
Domo - Drums

Host: Cheryl Waters
